developer_request: Understand this repository in its three-repository system and continue the next MingOS work without turning every task into a three-repo project.
known_facts: The repository README assigns different responsibilities to the Foundation, MingOS, and Family product repositories.
The cross-repository coordination document is explicitly Proposed navigation/coordination and says it does not replace each repository's own fact sources.
The downstream Foundation dependency record is also Proposed and says upstream main must be re-read before a new release, protocol, or cross-repository claim when the recorded baseline may be stale.
Product evidence may inform an upstream proposal but does not automatically become shared protocol or Foundation authority.
expected_first_moves: Anchor MingOS as the active work target and use its local coordination/dependency records to understand repository roles.
Identify whether the immediate MingOS decision actually depends on a claim owned by Foundation or Family-Space.

If the local dependency snapshot is current and sufficient, remain in MingOS; if it is stale or insufficient for a material claim, read only the smallest authoritative upstream/downstream source needed and record its exact status/revision.
Return to the MingOS decision after external evidence is collected; request or establish separate scope before mutating another repository.
must_preserve: The directional ownership boundary between principles/governance, shared protocol/kernel, and family product implementation.
The Proposed status and limitations of coordination/dependency records.
The rule that successful product behavior is evidence for review rather than automatic upstream authority.
must_not: Read all three repositories for every ordinary MingOS task merely because a repository map exists.
Treat a local coordination snapshot as a permanent replacement for the current authoritative source in another repository.
Mutate Foundation or Family-Space merely because they were inspected for evidence.
Promote a product-specific finding into MingOS/Foundation by silently expanding the current task into cross-repository edits.
lessons: Repository maps describe authority and dependency edges; they do not automatically create multi-repository execution scope.

Cross-repository evidence should be fetched only when the current decision needs a claim owned elsewhere or a local dependency record is stale/insufficient, and evidence access must remain separate from mutation authorization.
